nodes.statement: Exact internal symmetry Z3_m x Z3_E
A and B are local Lorentz-scalar SM singlets with charges (1,0) and (0,1)
All Standard-Model fields are neutral under the dual symmetry
Projected charge qP=q_m+q_E has a three-element kernel
A and B have equal projected charge and unequal kernel charge
Cross kinetic, bilinear, mixed-cubic, phase-sensitive quartic, and off-diagonal Higgs-portal operators are forbidden
Forbidden-operator surface is perturbatively RG invariant
Kernel-changing S-matrix amplitudes vanish in exact TP-D
An inert tree-level benchmark satisfies sufficient dark-sector global-origin and dark-scalar high-energy unitarity conditions
The full H+A+B quartic potential has exact three-field copositivity conditions
Benchmark B0 has an analytically certified global inert electroweak tree-level vacuum
The complete 36-channel high-energy scalar/Goldstone quartic spectrum reduces to fixed multiplicities plus a three-by-three singlet block
Two independent one-loop scalar-quartic RGE derivations agree coefficient by coefficient
B0 loses the one-loop absolute-BFB condition near 3.57e8 GeV; diagnostic B1 remains BFB until its perturbative boundary near 7.18e14 GeV
B0 passes the complete finite-energy physical-scalar partial-wave test from threshold to 20 TeV
Gamma(B -> A + h)=0 when the channel is kinematically open and the kernel symmetry is exact
Find a nonzero overconstrained relation not reproducible by a tuned generic Z3
Complete gauge-sector finite-energy unitarity, dimensionful and higher-loop TP-D RGEs, metastability, and current-data phenomenology
Later gravity/flavour/unification modules may be promoted only after O1 and O2 are resolved
